# jan.ucc.nau.edu

> Faculty directory and research profiles for Northern Arizona University faculty members in humanities, social sciences, and mathematics.

jan.ucc.nau.edu hosts personal and professional pages for NAU faculty, featuring research interests, publications, and course information. The site serves as a hub for accessing faculty expertise across disciplines including English literature, mathematics, sociology, and women's studies.

## Key Topics

- Northern Arizona University (NAU)
- Faculty profiles
- English Department
- Mathematics research
- Women's and Gender Studies
- Welfare studies
- Ethnographic research
- Educational research
- Publications and journals
- Course listings
- Flagstaff, Arizona
- Liberal Arts Building
- Budapest Semesters
- Rocky Mountain Journal of Mathematics
- Academic programs

## Faculty Profiles

- [Frances Julia Riemer](https://jan.ucc.nau.edu/fjr3/): Frances Julia Riemer's faculty profile with research on welfare and ethnographic studies.
- [Nancy L. Paxton](https://jan.ucc.nau.edu/~paxton/): Nancy L. Paxton's faculty homepage at NAU English Department.
- [Nándor Sieben](https://jan.ucc.nau.edu/ns46/): Nándor Sieben's faculty profile focusing on mathematics and graph theory research.
